_doc: Asset manifest fragment for the Warrior line (merged into asset_manifest.json by tools/wzimport and AssetManifest; docs/ASSET_PIPELINE.md 4.1). Spec #151 ticket #158 (shield slot): every non-cash Character.wz/Shield item a Warrior can wear, whole imgs (info, iconRaw and the stand/walk/... layers): canonical reqJob 1 (Warrior bit) 1092000-1092002, 1092004-1092007, 1092009-1092017, 1092023-1092028, 1092036-1092038, 1092041, 1092042, 1092046, 1092058, 1092060, 1092061, and reqJob 0 (any job) 1092003, 1092008, 1092022, 1092030, 1092035, 1092052. The cash shields stay with the curated cash items in the shared file. Ticket #159 (weapon-family drops): every Warrior weapon of survivor/equipment_drops/warrior.json, the sword (130xxxx, 140xxxx), axe (131xxxx, 141xxxx), blunt (132xxxx, 142xxxx), spear (143xxxx) and polearm (144xxxx) items with the Warrior reqJob bit (88 weapons, including 1402000, the Two-handed Sword the shield's two-handed rule is tested with), whole imgs, so a drop has its icon and a worn weapon its art. The six afterimages those weapons name that no other fragment lists yet (swordOS, swordTS, swordTL, axe, spear, poleArm; variant 0 only, as the shared file does for swordOL and mace) are here because a setup loads the afterimage of every listed drop; if the common fragment (#154) lists them too, they are removed from here (an img may appear in one fragment only). Ticket #163 (Warrior first job): the skill book Skill.wz/100.img whole (the six Warrior skills with icons, effects and hit art) and the sounds of Iron Body 1001003 and Slash Blast 1001005 in Sound.wz/Skill.img; Power Strike's 1001004 sound is already listed by beginner.json (Three Snails' UOL target). The Lv 10 advancement grants (owner change after the spec): the Beginner Warrior's sword 1302077 (the worn weapon, never a drop) and the Steel Pipe 1322006 (a Lv 10 one-handed blunt, reqJob 0, so no drop list names it); the granted Spear 1432000 is already in the weapon list above.
